profile.name: Caleb Chandrasekar
profile.intro: I build thoughtful digital experiences — from useful web applications to intelligent systems. Curious by nature. Driven by purpose.

projects.title: AEGIS — banking risk intelligence
projects.description: A working risk-intelligence prototype that connects security telemetry, identity activity, and payment events. Replayable scenarios produce evidence-backed incidents, with deterministic rules and false-positive guards.
projects.role: Risk correlation engine & analyst dashboard prototype
projects.tags: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Python, FastAPI, CSS, Tailwind CSS
projects.imageAlt: AEGIS command center showing correlated incidents and evidence-backed risk analysis

projects.title: Satoshi Trace — offline investigations
projects.description: An offline desktop tool for correlating Bitcoin transactions with network evidence. Local imports, explainable lead scoring, wallet graphs, and exports keep case data on the workstation. Findings are investigative leads, not proof of wrongdoing.
projects.tags: JavaScript, Electron, SQLite, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS
projects.imageAlt: Satoshi Trace architecture: local evidence import, offline analysis, and explainable leads in a desktop workspace
projects.imageCaption: ARCHITECTURE ILLUSTRATION / NOT AN APPLICATION SCREENSHOT

projects.title: Voice RAG College Counsellor
projects.description: A voice admissions assistant for a fictional university, pairing a Flutter client with a Python agent. Retrieval grounds answers in a static knowledge base, with a keyword-search fallback and deferral when information is missing.
projects.role: Voice agent, retrieval pipeline & Flutter client
projects.imageAlt: Voice counsellor architecture: Flutter client connects through a token API and LiveKit to a Python agent with retrieval over static documents
projects.imageCaption: ARCHITECTURE ILLUSTRATION / NOT AN APPLICATION SCREENSHOT
